message:
Target 3 is incomplete. The original task requirement (lines 102-104) explicitly requires Block to have three new fields with corresponding builder methods:

- `titles_style: Style` — patched onto all titles (set via `title_style()`)
- `titles_alignment: Alignment` — default alignment for titles without explicit alignment (set via `title_alignment()`)
- `titles_position: Position` — default position for titles without explicit position (set via `title_position()`)

Current Block struct in `/app/src/widgets/block/mod.rs` is missing all three fields. The deprecated `title_style()`, `title_alignment()`, and `title_on_bottom()` methods modify the last title only - they don't provide default values for all titles.

Please add these three required fields to the Block struct and implement their corresponding builder methods before continuing with Target 4.
